cards.title: Separable nonclassical state
cards.numerical_form: 4x4 density matrix; negativity and optimized discord

checks.reason: The four terms and coefficients are explicit in Eq. (1).
Trace, positivity, PPT, and discord are evaluated independently.

cards.title: Quantum discord
derived_from: mutual information minus optimized classical correlation
cards.numerical_form: dense projective grid for Eq. (1); eigenphase grid for DQC1

checks.reason: All entropy terms and the projective optimization are explicit.
alpha=0 has zero discord and the Eq. (1) state remains positive.

cards.title: DQC1 final state
cards.numerical_form: dense block matrix for independent small-n validation

checks.reason: Eq. (9) prints every block and normalization factor.
The control coherence reproduces alpha Tr(U)/2^n.

cards.title: DQC1 spectra and entropies
derived_from: unitary diagonalization of the block matrix

checks.reason: Eqs. (10)-(13) print the spectrum and entropy formulas.
Dense eigenvalues agree to machine precision.

cards.title: Post-measurement eigenphase spectrum
cards.latex: q_{k+-}=(1+-alpha cos(theta_k-phi))/(2^n[1+-alpha(tau_R cos phi+tau_I sin phi)])
derived_from: spectral theorem for U and one-qubit projectors

checks.reason: The conditional probabilities and phase convention are explicit.
Both conditional spectra normalize for every sampled phase.

cards.title: Finite eigenphase sum
cards.latex: Htilde=n-2^(-n-1) sum_k[log(1-alpha^2 cos^2 theta_k)+alpha cos theta_k log((1+alpha cos theta_k)/(1-alpha cos theta_k))]
derived_from: Eq. (20) with typical tau approximately zero
cards.numerical_form: 500 QR-Haar and 500 independent local-circuit U(32) eigenphase sets with every instance value frozen

checks.reason: Eq. (21) and the Main Fig. 1 caption define the sum, n=5, and ensemble size.
Both independent ensembles retain pointwise values, sampling uncertainty, eigenphases, and generator provenance; no ad hoc curve-distance threshold is used.

open_questions: The paper does not publish its pseudorandom seed or raw 500-instance array.

checks.reason: Eq. (23) and its endpoint are printed explicitly.
The discrete root limit and alpha endpoints agree with the closed form.

cards.title: Constructive control-register separability
derived_from: spectral theorem for the controlled unitary
positive control factors with eigenvalues (1 plus or minus alpha)/2
cards.numerical_form: explicit product-mixture reconstruction across n, alpha, and five unitary-path stages

checks.reason: The DQC1 block state and all-time separability claim are explicit in the paper.
The product mixture reconstructs the block state to machine precision and every factor is positive.

cards.title: Grouped-partition entanglement witnesses
cards.numerical_form: all grouped-control bipartitions through five register qubits

checks.reason: The grouped-partition negativity claim is explicit in the paper.
Zero negativity or realignment norm below one is recorded as non-detection, never as a separability proof.

cards.title: First symmetric-extension feasibility problem
derived_from: first level of the cited Doherty hierarchy
cards.numerical_form: machine-readable variable dimensions and affine/PSD constraint contract

checks.reason: The paper explicitly cites the first Doherty level and a private calculation.
The exact SDP dimensions and constraints are emitted; no result is claimed without a PSD-cone solver and certificate.

open_questions: The paper gives no solver, tolerance, seed, or primal/dual certificate for the cited private calculation.

cards.title: Finite root-grid periodicity
cards.latex: {2 pi k/N - phi} is permutation invariant only for phi=2 pi m/N at finite N
cards.numerical_form: phi sweeps for N=4 through 4096 and alpha=0.5,1

checks.reason: The finite root placement and phi-independence wording is explicit in the paper.
Finite N=32 discord varies with phi while the variation converges toward zero as N grows.

open_questions: The literal finite-N phrasing is false; the continuum-limit statement remains valid.

cards.title: Fixed-accuracy DQC1 sampling overhead
derived_from: bounded variance of a Pauli control measurement
normalized trace obtained by division by alpha
cards.numerical_form: exact integer shot bound over four polarizations, four register sizes and fixed RMS error

checks.reason: The paper explicitly states the 1/alpha squared repetition overhead for fixed accuracy.
The generated shot counts scale exactly as 1/alpha squared and do not depend on n.
